items.title: CISA adds actively exploited WSO2 and Adobe Commerce flaws to KEV catalog
items.summary: CVE-2026-5430 (CVSS 9.8, WSO2 products, file upload leading to RCE) and CVE-2026-71362 (CVSS 9.1, Adobe Commerce/Magento account takeover) are under active attack; federal agencies must patch by September 27.

items.title: F5 patches critical BIG-IP APM zero-day under active exploitation
items.summary: CVE-2026-94127 (CVSS 9.8) is a heap-based buffer overflow in BIG-IP APM OAuth setups. CISA added it to the KEV catalog with a Friday patch deadline for federal agencies.

items.title: September 2026 Patch Tuesday: fixes for two zero-days among ~1,000 updates
items.summary: Microsoft's September Patch Tuesday fixed two zero-day flaws plus hundreds of other vulnerabilities across Windows and services.

items.title: GitLab critical patch release fixes 11 flaws, two CVSS 9.9 RCEs
items.summary: CVE-2026-89078 and CVE-2026-93577 allow authenticated RCE via malformed regex. Self-managed admins urged to upgrade to 19.4.1, 19.3.3, or 19.2.7 immediately.

items.title: Check Point patches zero-day CVE-2026-93616 exploited in July attacks
items.summary: CVSS 9.8 unauthenticated remote code execution in the Security Management Server, abused via path traversal and file upload. LivePatch does not fix it — a full security hotfix is required.

items.title: ShinyHunters hacked the Clop ransomware leak site
items.summary: The extortion group breached Clop's Tor data-leak site via a Grav CMS file-upload flaw, defaced it, and claims to have stolen server data including the site's onion private keys — enabling long-term impersonation of the rival gang.
